sloka: त्यजैनं बलवान्कालो मा प्रतिज्ञां वृथा कृताः ।विनष्टायां प्रतिज्ञायां धर्मो ऽपि च लयं व्रजेत् ।। ७.१०६.९ ॥
transliteration: tyajainaṁ balavānkālo mā pratijñāṁ vṛthā kṛtāḥ ।vinaṣṭāyāṁ pratijñāyāṁ dharmo 'pi ca layaṁ vrajet ।। 7.106.9 ॥

translations.english: Abandon him, for time is powerful; do not let your vow be made in vain, because if the vow is violated, even righteousness will meet its dissolution.
